KEEP_ALL.name: Always-rest ladder
KEEP_ALL.entry: Post whenever the shared ladder permits
KEEP_ALL.resting: No learned cancellation; shared structural handling remains

FILL_GUARD.name: Fill-probability guard
FILL_GUARD.model: STOP-EV v3 fill head only; original saved QR thresholds
FILL_GUARD.entry: Wait when fresh P(fill) exceeds the saved threshold
FILL_GUARD.resting: Pull when P(fill) exceeds the saved threshold

SWEEP_GUARD.name: Sweep-risk guard
SWEEP_GUARD.model: STOP-MODEL v6, 1s sweep-risk heads; original saved thresholds
SWEEP_GUARD.entry: Wait when predicted through-price risk is too high
SWEEP_GUARD.resting: Pull the order when its depth-adjusted sweep risk is too high

STOP_EV.name: STOP-EV strategy
STOP_EV.model: STOP-EV v3 full 71 market +12 order inputs; P(fill) times mean filled value

ARRIVAL_EV.name: Arrival forecast + STOP-EV guard
ARRIVAL_EV.model: Side-specific arrival residual models + frozen STOP-EV v3 guard
ARRIVAL_EV.entry: Post when forecast of same-price arrival teacher value is nonnegative

FUTURE_ENTRY.name: Future-informed entry diagnostic
FUTURE_ENTRY.model: Future arrival teacher score + frozen STOP-EV v3 guard
FUTURE_ENTRY.entry: Post using future information; NONCAUSAL diagnostic

recorded58.feed: recorded observation clocks; deterministic recorded order medians

zero_all.feed: zero modeled feed delay; recorded events; 50ms grid remains

freeze.population: Same 1434 first-minute windows, five consumed dates, six Oct31 boundary exclusions; all fills. Registry outcome used only for accounting.
freeze.valuation: Gross YES-equivalent cash/inventory; pre-fill last valid book strictly before modeled fill time; post-fill last valid book <= fill+h at100/500/1000/5000ms; terminal60.2s; remaining inventory held to recorded binary resolution.
freeze.missing: Missing required marks/outcome refuse completed output; stale (>1s) marks counted without outcome-based filtering. Prior loader exclusions retained with counts.
freeze.nulls: No inferential null, significance claim or policy selection; descriptive accounting only.
freeze.limits: Gross simulated accounting; fees/rewards/impact not added. Only first-minute trading followed by passive settlement hold. M50/queueM; no new robustness or physical validation claim. Old reported markouts use unshifted anchors and are separately reconciled.

limits: Descriptive gross replay accounting; previously consumed dates; no inference or selection; settlement is passive carry after first-minute trading.
